label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Hi Mum, Kirsty and Linda,

So here’s the plan for Gran’s 80th, and I’m buzzing about it. Her birthday is Sun 13 Dec, and the dinner’s booked for 8.30 that night at the Italian place on Byres Rd — table for 9. That’s me, Mum, Kirsty, Linda, Gran, Ava and Ruby, plus Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man.

Before that, I’ve got the salon to myself on Sat 12 Dec from 1pm (Morag shuts at 12), so I’m doing everyone’s hair for free. It’s Hair by Morag on Dumbarton Rd, yous all know it. That’s seven heads in total. Gran doesn’t know yet, so keep it quiet.

I need to know what yous want done by Fri 27 Nov at the latest so I can order stuff in from the wholesaler. Cuts and blowdries are fine for everyone; colours only if you tell me in time. Mum, can you get Gran there for 1 without telling her why? She said at Easter she’d love to go silver properly but wouldnae pay salon prices, so I’d love to sort that for her. Linda, I’ll be keeping a close eye on you after the cooker and the dog incident in your kitchen — maybe bring old clothes just in case. Ava and Ruby can get wee braids and glitter spray, they’ll be made up.

Bring a bottle of fizz if yous want; Morag says that’s fine as long as we tidy up after ourselves. Can yous let me know asap please? I really want this to be a good one for her.

Love,
[Your name]
